description: A tariff headline cuts fair value 2% into a ladder of 5x-50x leveraged longs. Baseline: no leverage. Variants: the leverage ladder with a deep insurance fund (every liquidation hits the book), with auto-deleveraging once a small insurance fund is used up, or with a 10x leverage cap.

variants.name: ladder
variants.label: 5x-50x leverage ladder
variants.change: Thirty longs with 5x to 50x leverage (20 lots each); every liquidation is sold into the book.

variants.name: adl
variants.label: Ladder + auto-deleveraging
variants.change: The same ladder, but once a small insurance fund is used up, bankrupt positions are closed against the most profitable shorts instead of the book.

variants.name: leverage_cap
variants.label: Ladder with a 10x cap
variants.change: The same traders, but the venue caps leverage at 10x.
